svg.title: Triage: Alcohol-marker sketch cards
svg.desc: Triage (1D): a table of patient cards drawn in alcohol marker on white card stock, streaky layered tones and quick ink faces. Each card has a name and one want in the corner and a row of small amber marks for the tincture. Three columns across the table, NOW, WAIT and CANNOT; the tincture tray at the left holds more marks than there are cots, and one card already has a mark more than it needed, drawn in a darker amber.
svg.text: A mark past the need settles a card at once.
